# Coastal View Hotel & Resort, Mandarmani (Managed By Ani's)

> Premier boutique beachfront luxury resort situated directly on the shores of Mandarmani, West Bengal. Managed and curated by Anirban Das and Ani's Tour & Travels.

## Overview
- **Location:** Rina Rd, Mandarmani, West Bengal 721455, India.
- **Distance:** ~170 km from Kolkata (~3.5 to 4 hours via NH16 & NH116B).
- **Telephone / Front Desk:** +91 9620536361
- **Management:** Managed By Ani's (Founder: Anirban Das).
- **Key Amenities:** Direct private beachfront access, infinity swimming pool, The Bay Breeze Bengali fine dining restaurant, The Coral Reef Cocktail Lounge, romantic candlelight beach dinners, private cab hire and sightseeing.

## Room Types & Accommodations
Coastal View features 4 distinct boutique room and suite categories:

### 1. The Ocean Whisper Room
- **Category Tag:** SEA VIEW
- **View:** Sea-facing with private balcony views of the pool, garden, and sea in the distance
- **Target Guest:** Ideal for couples and romantic getaways
- **Bed:** Comfortable King Bed
- **Size:** 450 sq. ft.
- **Capacity:** Max 2 Adults + 1 Child
- **Features & Highlights:**
  - Private balcony with views of the pool, garden, and sea
  - Silent split air conditioning & high-speed Wi-Fi
  - Wall-mounted Smart TV with streaming apps
  - Modern en-suite bathroom with 24/7 hot & cold rainfall shower
- **Price:** ₹6,800 / night (20% advance: ₹1,360)

### 2. The Pool Haven Room
- **Category Tag:** POOL VIEW
- **View:** Swimming pool and garden view from private balcony
- **Target Guest:** Water lovers and couples
- **Bed:** Plush King Bed
- **Size:** 480 sq. ft.
- **Capacity:** Max 2 Adults + 1 Child
- **Features & Highlights:**
  - Private balcony overlooking the swimming pool and garden
  - Climate control air conditioning & high-speed Wi-Fi
  - Wall-mounted Smart TV with streaming apps
  - Modern private bathroom with hot & cold shower
- **Price:** ₹7,200 / night (20% advance: ₹1,440)

### 3. Cosy Deluxe Room
- **Category Tag:** NON-SEA FACING (Cosy Deluxe)
- **View:** Tropical garden and inner courtyard side
- **Target Guest:** Budget-conscious travelers, quiet retreats, solo travelers, and couples
- **Bed:** Comfortable Queen Bed
- **Size:** 380 sq. ft.
- **Capacity:** Max 2 Adults + 1 Child
- **Features & Highlights:**
  - Quiet location overlooking courtyard greenery
  - Split air conditioning & high-speed Wi-Fi
  - Smart TV with cable and streaming support
  - Clean, hygienic modern en-suite bathroom
- **Price:** Economical rate (managed via live front desk admin panel; defaults to "Ask at hotel" until saved)

### 4. The Palm Grove Family Suite
- **Category Tag:** FAMILY SUITE
- **View:** Palm and garden surroundings
- **Target Guest:** Families with children and vacation groups
- **Bed:** Two Beds (King Bed + Extra Bed or two spacious beds)
- **Size:** 850 sq. ft.
- **Capacity:** Max 4 Adults + 2 Children
- **Features & Highlights:**
  - Expansive family suite surrounded by tropical palms and landscaped gardens
  - Dedicated sitting lounge and family living area
  - Dual modern en-suite bathrooms
  - Private wide garden-facing veranda
- **Price:** ₹11,500 / night (20% advance: ₹2,300)

## Reservation & Payment Policy
- **Occupancy Policy:** Each standard room accommodates up to 2 Adults and 1 Child (complimentary stay for children aged up to 5 years). Extra person/bed inquiries can be confirmed with the front desk. For larger parties, please reserve multiple rooms.
- **Confirmation Advance:** 20% non-refundable advance deposit payable online via UPI / Cards / Net Banking to lock in live room dates.
- **Balance Payment:** Remaining 80% balance is payable directly at hotel check-in or check-out.
- **Live Inventory:** Real-time sold-out toggling directly synced between front desk admin panel, website booking engine, and the Coastal Concierge AI.
